skill2: ■ Activates when Sing Along takes effect while Prika is in Performance status. Encore — Function: Extends the duration of Performance for Prika and strengthens allies.
Effect 1: Affects the member who initiated Sing Along. Assigned Part: Singing. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.
Effect 2: Affects all allies. Performance duration ▲ 21 sec.
Effect 3: Affects all allies. Attack Damage ▲ 25.01% for 10 sec.
Effect 4: Affects self. Cooldown of Burst Skill ▲ 21 sec.

notes: Reconciliation points, highest-risk first. (1) BURST-SLOT FIXTURE: prika is Burst II — controlComp() already seats crown at B2, so a naive fixture may leave prika NEVER casting her burst (zero Performance, zero HoT, zero chargeDamagePct, zero pierce). Tests must build a comp where prika actually occupies/wins the B2 cast, and the burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter distinction for the burst block is only observable in a comp where the OTHER B2 sometimes bursts — expect a shared-prior misread here (keying Charge Damage + Performance to fullBurstEnter over-credits ~2× uptime). (2) PERFORMANCE = her own burst status: the skill1 self block (healing + pierce) must be windowed to the 25s post-cast window; the classic misread is top-level hasPierce:true (whole-fight). Also note the burst's two 'cannot be removed' 25s effects and the Performance window share duration — if the driver modeled Performance as a mode or a 10s FB window instead of 25s, pierce and charge-damage uptime both break. (3) casterAtkPct vs atkPct on the skill1 ally feed — buffApply value must be a FLAT number equal on all targets. (4) The HoT must be ticks:25 — with crown in-comp this is the biggest tandem lever; ticks:1 is the near-certain misread. (5) Encore is entirely cross-unit-gated (Sing Along has no engine channel and, afaik, no roster initiator); any modeled Encore effect — especially the 25.01% Attack Damage team buff — is an over-credit, and Effect 4 is a burst-CD INCREASE (self-nerf), not a reduction; if a Sing-Along carrier ever lands, prika's effective CD becomes 61s while Encore procs, which also invalidates any 40s-cadence assertion. (6) Uptime of all three skill1 ally buffs rides her charge cadence (chargeFrames 60 ⚑ ALWAYS-flag) and lapses across the 141f reload — assert a refresh-per-shot pattern, not a permanent buff.

divergences.line: S1 "Gains Pierce continuously while in Performance"
divergences.reviewer: FAITHFUL + load-bearing — model as gainPierce durationSec 25 on burstCast (windowed to Performance), NOT top-level hasPierce.
divergences.driver: UNMODELED ⚑ MEASUREMENT-GATED. The owner EXPLICITLY held this line "pending a popup measurement" (probe-runs 2026-07-14 inconclusive); the gauntlet has no new measurement data. Per MEASURED>FUDGE + respect for the owner hold, driver FLAGS rather than enacts. Estimate (~+8% personal SR damage from her own 13.09% pierceDamagePct going live during the 25s Performance window, ~62% uptime), recipe (Prika-focus popup pass confirming the Pierce tag + in/out-window SR uplift), tier 2 — all in the test header. This is the F1 cold hypothesis; the test P2 inertness assertion captures the mechanism (pierceDamagePct applies but spends nothing until a Pierce tag exists).
divergences.resolution: FLAG (⚑). Reviewer is mechanically correct that gainPierce is the faithful encoding IF enacted; driver defers enactment to the owner measurement the line is explicitly gated on.

divergences.line: Burst Effect 1 HoT (3.04% caster max HP / 1s × 25s, all allies)
divergences.reviewer: FAITHFUL + load-bearing — model as heal ticks:25/intervalSec:1 (25 recovery events per cast) to drive crown-type on-recovery consumers; nearest-wrong ticks:1.

No owner measurement-gate, but minimum-edit principle + no crown in the graded fixture keep it as a documented gap. Recipe: add heal ticks:25 on burstCast/allies if a crown-type consumer is graded. Tier 2.

divergences.driver: Shipped override models Effect 3 (attackDamagePct 25.01/10s) + Effect 4 (burstCdr -21) as a SOLO-MODE PROXY on fullBurstEnter/burstCast — the owner deliberate, documented approximation ("Sing Along/Performance is an untracked mechanic, so I approximate it as firing once per rotation on Full Burst entry"). The test P4/P6 PIN this shipped encoding (value/dur/target/cadence/sign); the header ⚑ documents that the solo proxy OVER-CREDITS in non-Mint comps (the real trigger needs a Sing Along caster).
